# Task Breakdown - 2026-09-02

## Task 1: Separate environment details from user prompt text for better caching

**Category**: command
**Size**: MODERATE (~4h)
**Source**: Kilocode #13190
**Status**: NEW (to be created as GitHub issue)

### What

Separate `<environment_details>` block from user prompt text by prefixing it with blank lines (e.g. `\n\n<environment_details>...`). Apply same separation to switch/plan reminder blocks. Update prompt-cache detection to trim leading whitespace before matching block start tags.

### Why

- Improves prompt-cache hit ratio for Claude models (cache hits save latency + cost)
- Prevents duplicate env-block injection in repeated loop iterations
- Better prompt hygiene: stable baseline ends at user text, variable env block is separate suffix

### How

**Files to modify:**

1. **`src/cli/interactive.ts`** (primary env details injection site)
   - Search for `<environment_details>` construction
   - Add `\n\n` prefix before the opening tag
   - Verify switch/plan reminder blocks also get blank-line separation

2. **`src/core/sessionContext.ts`** (cross-session context provider)
   - Audit any env-detail injection in session context building
   - Add blank-line separator if missing

3. **`src/core/agenticChat.ts`** (system prompt builder)
   - Check cache-friendly ordering logic (line ~383)
   - Ensure env details are separated from stable prefix

4. **`src/providers/openai/prompt-cache.ts`** (cache breakpoint detection)
   - Update `applyCacheBreakpoint` to trim leading whitespace before matching
   - Prevents blank-line prefix from breaking block detection

**Implementation steps:**

1. Grep for `<environment_details>` construction across codebase
2. Add `\n\n` prefix to all env-block injection sites
3. Update cache detection to `.trim().startsWith('<environment_details>')` instead of raw `.startsWith`
4. Add test coverage for duplicate-block prevention
5. Verify no duplicate blocks appear in repeated prompts

**Test coverage:**

- Test env block injected with blank-line prefix
- Test duplicate-block prevention (repeated calls don't append multiple env blocks)
- Test cache detection works with trimmed whitespace
- Test normal prompts unchanged

### Done when

- [ ] `<environment_details>` block prefixed with `\n\n` at all injection sites
- [ ] Cache detection trims leading whitespace before matching block tags
- [ ] No duplicate blocks in repeated loop iterations
- [ ] Tests verify blank-line separation and duplicate prevention
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Manual test: repeated prompts show single env block with proper separation

## Task 2: Sanitize API keys at write boundary and classify auth errors

**Category**: provider + config
**Size**: HIGH (~6h)
**Source**: Cline #13549
**Status**: EXISTING — Issue #1625 already created yesterday, already in auto-implement queue

### What

(1) Strip control characters, formatting characters, and whitespace from pasted API keys at config write boundary. (2) Classify HTTP 401/403 as `ProviderErrorClass: 'auth'` with actionable user guidance.

### Why

- Prevents invisible clipboard artifacts (newlines, zero-width spaces, BOM) from causing 401s
- Rewrites unhelpful raw provider JSON into actionable guidance
- Better UX for BYOK users

### How

**See issue #1625 for complete implementation details.**

Key files:
- `src/config/index.ts` or `src/providers/auth.ts` (sanitization)
- `src/core/errors.ts` (error classification)
- `src/cli/interactive.ts` (error display)
- `tests/config/sanitization.test.ts` (NEW)
- `tests/core/errors.test.ts` (extend)

### Done when

- [ ] See issue #1625 checklist
